title: Private Console: Network & Cluster Health Dashboard + Rollout Journey
creator: Aisha Martinez
description:
Problem: Customers running Private/VPC deployments have fragmented tooling for understanding network topology impacts, cluster health, and the status of staged model rollouts. Operators currently must jump between the cluster list, a separate networking canvas, and the rollout page; this increases time-to-diagnosis during incidents and adds cognitive load when planning upgrades.

Goal: Design a consolidated console experience that surfaces: (1) per-cluster health and networking indicators at a glance, (2) a guided rollout journey with preflight checks, canary monitoring hooks, and rollback affordances, and (3) integrated cost signals (per-token and GPU-hour estimates) so engineers can balance latency vs cost during rollout decisions.

Deliverables: 
- High-fidelity dashboard prototype (Figma) combining cluster cards, network flow health, and active rollout timeline.
- Rollout journey wireframes for canary → ramp → global with inline preflight check UI and one-click rollback.
- Cost overlay designs that show incremental cost delta for a rollout change (e.g., model variant, quantization profile, batch config).
- Interaction spec for state transitions (healthy → degraded → degraded+network) and accessibility notes.

Acceptance Criteria: 
- Dashboard prototype demonstrates a single screen for on-call operators to identify: affected cluster(s), suspected network segments, and active rollouts within 3 clicks.
- Rollout journey includes a preflight checklist (compatibility, KV cache warm, capacity) and a visible guardrail for automatic fallback.
- Cost overlay calculates and displays estimated per-hour and per-1M-token cost deltas for the chosen rollout configuration.
- Prototype passes two internal usability sessions with platform engineers and one quick validation with a pilot customer (Customer X).
design_artifacts: Figma: cost overlay microcopy and tooltip states
comments: 2026-03-02 | Liam Chen: First pass of the consolidated dashboard done. Placed cluster and rollout timeline side-by-side; need to explore tighter coupling between network fault lanes and rollout events.

2026-03-04 | Priya Kapoor (PM): Love the single-pane approach. Request: include an explicit 'safety budget' indicator tied to Dedicated capacity (shows remaining burst hours). Also want quick-links to run a preflight smoke test.

2026-03-05 | Marco Ruiz (Eng): Prototype looks great. Concern: preflight checks that query KV cache status may add latency to the rollout flow. Suggest an async check with cached last-known state and a forced live re-check option.

2026-03-07 | UX Research: Two internal usability sessions completed (platform engs n=6). Key finding: operators expect network segment names to be search-filterable and prefer inline incident links to the cluster timeline.
2026-03-09 | Security (Anna Li): Policy question: exposing per-token cost estimates with customer identifiers. Confirmed OK for internal pilot; flag for final privacy review before GA.
2026-03-10 | Aisha Martinez: Updated prototype to include async preflight pattern and cost overlay mockups. Ready for design review sync on 2026-03-11.
notes: Next steps: run two customer-facing validation sessions (pilot customers), hand off interaction spec to eng (ENG-2812) for feasibility review, and sync with infra to expose cost telemetry endpoints. Plan a small a/b test for rollout affordances in a staging environment.

Rollout journey includes preflight checks, canary metrics, and one-click rollback

Prototype validated with at least 2 internal sessions and 1 pilot customer
